description: Grants IPC + core permissions ONLY to the local 'chrome' webview (the tab bar / settings / error surfaces). This is the entire native-API surface of the app. The remote pod webviews (labels 'pod-*') are intentionally listed in NO capability and NO remote URL appears anywhere, so the Tauri ACL denies every command invocation originating from a pod page. `local: true` further restricts this grant to local (tauri://) content, so even the chrome webview would lose access if it were ever navigated to a remote origin.
